# Rig Configurator
> Fit-checked truck and SUV accessories. Pick a vehicle generation; see only the tonneau covers, racks, hitches, liners and steps the makers list for it, with live Amazon prices.

Every guide covers one vehicle generation. Fit comes from manufacturer fit guides and part-number listings, checked against owner reports; we do not install the products ourselves. Sources are cited on every guide.

## Guides
- https://rigconfigurator.com/vehicles — 32 vehicle hubs
- https://rigconfigurator.com/guides — category guides by vehicle
- https://rigconfigurator.com/learn — explainers and data charts (bed lengths, roof load limits, factory hitches)
- https://rigconfigurator.com/tools — tongue weight and roof load calculators
- https://rigconfigurator.com/sitemap.xml
